method: Public web search and official provider pages; no existing Superwin games inspected or tested, no backend/wallet/database changes, no production wagers.
environmentBlocker: Execution workspace became unavailable before report could be written locally or demo observation resumed.

rows.name: Multi Hot 40
rows.observation: Launcher loaded but provider reported 'You can create up to 1 tables simultaneously'. No game rounds completed.

rows.name: Multi Hot Deluxe
rows.note: Official page title is Multi Hot 5 Deluxe. Requested title omits 5. Do not silently label it an exact match.
rows.referenceDescription: Official page describes 3 reels, 3 rows, 5 paylines and classic fruit artwork.

rows.name: Super Hot
rows.note: Exact title on official Wazdan page; ZeusPlay also has this title and Amusnet has numbered Super Hot titles. ZPLAY-specific provider not established.
rows.referenceDescription: Official Wazdan page describes 3 reels/5 lines, flames and fruit symbols, x2 Wall Multiplier and a gamble feature. Public asset links exist on the page.

rows.name: Burning Hot
rows.referenceDescription: Official page identifies game ID 801, 5 reels by 3 rows, 5 fixed lines; fruits, expanding wild and two scatter symbols. Demo button offered; runtime not observed.

rows.name: Sizzling Hot
rows.note: Provider confirms original title in official releases. Sizzling Hot deluxe is a distinct version; runtime and exact ZPLAY build not established.

rows.name: Ultra Hot
rows.note: Original Ultra Hot appears in the historical official catalogue; accessible current product page is Ultra Hot deluxe. Do not substitute deluxe silently.

rows.name: Fruit Slot
rows.referenceDescription: Official Spearhead/SlotMatrix sheet identifies FruitSlot, a circular 24-position Asian arcade board, not a conventional reel game.
rows.note: Multiple exact-title/candidate publishers; SmartSoft-specific title unverified.

rows.name: Fruits'n Sevens
rows.note: Official catalogue pages 100–101 identify the exact non-deluxe title. Separate Fruits'n Sevens deluxe also exists; no direct official runtime verified.

rows.name: Sevens & Fruits
rows.referenceDescription: Official provider page identifies 5×3 layout, 5 lines, vivid fruit/seven symbols, fire animations and classic sounds; no special bonuses or free spins.

rows.name: Three Sevens
rows.note: Independent catalogues agree on InBet/ABXplay. Casino Guru says its demo is temporarily unavailable. No official primary runtime established.

rows.name: Double Sevens
rows.note: Secondary listings identify 3 reels/5 lines and GTECH/IGT; primary current demo not found.

rows.name: Super Sevens
rows.referenceDescription: Official Belatra page offers free play without registration; five lines, traditional sevens/cherries/oranges/bars, red-black or suit gamble.
rows.note: Belatra is an exact-title candidate, but requested ZPLAY variant is not established.

rows.name: Lucky Seven
rows.note: SlotCatalog and Chipy identify a SmartSoft scratch-card game; SlotCatalog specifies 6×4 board. Stakers instead describes a 3-reel, 1-line slot. Primary official demo required to resolve conflicting descriptions.

rows.name: Lucky Eight
rows.note: Search returned unrelated card apps, casino entities and Lucky 8 by RTG. Lucky 8 is separately requested as #58; do not treat as confirmed alias.

rows.name: Lucky Eight Win
rows.note: Targeted searches returned unrelated matches, with no identified official casino game or demo. This is not a claim that no such game exists.

rows.name: Lucky Lady's Charm
rows.note: Official provider announcements name the original title. Current product pages also include deluxe and other variants; original ZPLAY runtime not verified.

rows.name: Diamond Seven
rows.note: Found Diamond 7’s by Microgaming as a nearby title, unrelated mobile apps, and operator lists without reliable identity. None proves exact requested SmartSoft title; do not substitute.

rows.name: Wild Cherries
rows.referenceDescription: Consistent catalogues describe 5×3 reels, 20 paylines, fruit symbols and cherry wilds.
rows.note: Provider identity supported by several secondary sources; direct official demo/runtime not verified.

rows.name: Wild Cherry
rows.referenceDescription: Official page describes polygon fruit artwork, 40-line video slot, expanding wilds, free spins and a Wheel of Fortune bonus.
rows.note: IGT also has a historical Wild Cherry machine; requested ZPLAY variant has not been established.

rows.name: Jackpot 6000
rows.referenceDescription: Official page offers Demo, describes 3×3 reels and 5 lines, Joker symbols, a heads-or-tails double-up and Supermeter mode.
rows.note: Public page verified; demo runtime and 15 rounds not observed.

rows.name: Fever Slots
rows.note: Official sources identify Fever Slots as an online casino/site containing many suppliers' games, not a single verified SmartSoft game. No exact standalone game found.

rows.name: Reel Rush
rows.referenceDescription: Official page describes variable-height 5-reel layout expanding through respins to 5×5, bright candy/fruit visuals, wild animation and free spins.
rows.note: Original Reel Rush identified separately from Reel Rush 2 and Reel Rush XXXtreme; runtime inspection interrupted by workspace loss.
